rules.close: commit closes the session; an uncommitted session is not part of the memory.
rules.form: Write every fact as 「X の Y は A」: X the WHOLE subject (the thing: 広報, 備品, 山本さんのチーム), Y what you are asked about (担当, 期限, ポート, 会場), A a noun phrase (山本, 水曜, 10.0.0.5, 大阪). One fact per sentence, a noun at the end, no verb, no chain of が を で に before it. Example: 「備品の期限は水曜」, not 「備品は水曜までに揃える」.
rules.frozen: Every cross a write made is frozen: unseat swap extend topic set_depth link unlink drop -> memory_frozen. add / open_cross / seat / emit are not tools of a memory session.
rules.history: A write is judged against the sentences BEFORE it, never against itself (REVERSAL / NEW_RELATION / UNANCHORED); notes never block.
rules.output: A memory session never emits: its only product is the sentences it writes. Plain text is discarded unread.
rules.recall: recall(question) asks the evidence gate (scope clause, evidence.v2) of the WHOLE memory: ANSWER (one group), CHOICE (two or more: contested facts stay listed, nothing is ranked), NONE (no sentence passes: the codes say why). Superseded sentences are returned under `history`, not as the answer.
rules.report: report(contradictions, bugs) ends EVERY turn: contradictions = pairs of turn ids ("1-3" = session 1, message 3) whose statements disagree, [] if none; bugs = [] here.
rules.supersede: A write that answers a question differently from an earlier sentence shows a SAME_QUESTION note (always). If the later statement REPLACES the earlier one (an explicit change, a postponement, a move), call supersede(new_sid, old_sid or old_answer, reason): recall then answers with the newest and lists the old ones as history (nothing is deleted). A real contradiction (no sign that one replaces the other) is left alone: recall shows CHOICE. A supersede that does not name an existing contested group is refused with a reason.
rules.topic: declare_topic(text) at the start of the session: what it is about (a noun phrase, at most 24 characters, no particle at the end). A sentence you write with no subject (「締め切りは水曜」) is stored as 「<topic>の締め切りは水曜」 and the result says so (implicit_topic). Declare it again when the subject changes.
rules.write: write(text, role) weaves the WHOLE sentence into the memory (at most 64 characters). A sentence the structure cannot seat is refused (span_inexpressible) and stores nothing: rewrite it in the form below and call write again. Every rewrite is counted as cost.
